decisions.reason: Replacing two proposal tables does not change the narrative packaging or fixed section-order requirements.
The source changes table artifacts only and does not alter photo selection or treatment.
The replacement tables remain within the existing full-document layout obligation and do not change its layout pass, input stage, or coverage.
Replacing proposal tables does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export quality.
The revised tables do not change the Agua Arc brand identity or supplied brand assets.
The source does not mention hyperlinks or change the requirement that they remain functional in the final file.
Replacing table content does not change Canva source delivery, edit access, ownership, or asset policy.
The source does not change the applicable page-limit goal or notification action; any effect of the revised tables on pagination is not specified.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and does not affect the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The table replacement does not change the agreed count of consolidated revision rounds.
Although the client acknowledges possible inconvenience, the source does not change any draft, revision, submission, or delivery deadline.
